steps.title: How many rows in sales?
steps.prompt: COUNT(*) answers 'how many rows?' with one number.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(*) FROM sales;

steps.title: Count the id values
steps.prompt: COUNT(column) counts rows where that column is not empty (it skips NULLs).
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT count(id) FROM sales;
steps.memory_trick: COUNT(column) skips NULLs; COUNT(*) skips nothing.
